plan.performanceScope: Five recorded groups after one predeclared discarded group; all six three-variant permutations. plan.memoryScope: Docker container memory display sampled at readiness and after both full probes, outside measured request windows. No forced GC or sampled peak claim.
plan.coldReadinessScope: Host wrapper stopwatch from immediately before docker run until successful readiness; includes Docker launch and polling. Per-host raw timestamps retained; not an application-only startup measurement.
